property_summary: For any call to play() with any sender and any msg.value, the reference contract C always leaves pot either increased by exactly TICKET_AMOUNT (10) when no payout occurs or reset to 0 after a payout; the mutant that removes the require can leave pot at other values (not equal to 0 or not a multiple of TICKET_AMOUNT increment), so there exist inputs (msg.value not equal to 10) where pot differs between C and the mutant.
change_summary: Change the require to accept any msg.value so pot may accumulate different amounts and observed pot after play can differ when callers send non-standard amounts.
